body:
Part of #98.

## Why

The README's multi-board section tells adopters to hand-maintain `~/.config/hkb/boards.json`, and #96
recently added a sentence saying a change to it needs `hkb serve` restarted. Both become wrong once
this track lands, and a README that describes the old friction is worse than one that says nothing.

## What

Rewrite the multi-board part of the "More than one repo" section (README.md, around lines 184-202):

- `hkb init` registers the checkout it sets up, so the list maintains itself — the common case needs no
  config at all.
- The file is still yours: still documented, still hand-editable, still the place to pin a non-default
  board with `#slug`, and `--repos` still overrides it for one run.
- Changes are picked up while the server runs. **Delete the sentence #96 added** ("The list is read
  once, while `hkb serve` starts, …") — it is now false.
- Keep the "Nothing is scanned for" promise and sharpen it: hkb still never crawls your filesystem
  looking for repos. A checkout registering itself at `hkb init` is not scanning — running `hkb init`
  there *is* the act of naming it. Say that, because it is the distinction that makes automatic
  registration compatible with the promise.
- Mention that `hkb init` prints where it registered, so nobody is surprised that init wrote outside
  the repo.

Match the surrounding prose: plain, second person, no bullet lists in that section.

## Done when

- The section describes the behaviour that actually shipped in this track's siblings — read them
  (`hkb show` the tasks this one is blocked by) rather than this description, which was written before
  they ran.
- `rg -n "read once, while .hkb serve. starts" README.md docs/` returns nothing.
- No other page still claims the list is manual or needs a restart: check `docs/manual-mode.md:48-49`,
  which mentions the file today.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green.

## Contract

- Use the exact `hkb init` message wording and the exact reload semantics your blockers shipped — quote
  them, do not paraphrase from this body.
- Docs only. Touch `README.md` (and `docs/manual-mode.md` if it is stale). No source, no test changes.
goal: the multi-board section describes automatic registration and live reload, with no stale restart claim
title: README: the board list maintains itself
